vector_memory.semantic_summary: SpecialistManager orchestrates the execution of specialized LLM workers for complex, unstructured tasks like code generation or file modification. It acts as a service layer, reading the current state of a target file (up to 3000 characters) to build a comprehensive context payload. This payload, along with a specialist's defined role, is sent via an injected connector to an external LLM service for specialized processing.
